title: [GMCP 203.034.M] Mastery: Audit, privacy, provenance, and compliance evidence
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-034-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: A single tamper-evident event model records MCP lifecycle, discovery, policy, consent, install, auth, invocation, data egress, callback, task and administrative outcomes with correlation and provenance but no secret or raw sensitive payload. Retention, deletion, export and subject boundaries are configurable; completeness canaries catch bypasses; and an evidence bundle reproduces every completion claim from immutable test and build artifacts. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
